music.textAlternative: A minim E with an ornament sign: the letters tr above the note.

hints: Look at the direction of the sign.
Small notes before the main note are grace notes; signs above the note are trills, turns and mordents.

mistakes.upper-lower-mordent-swap: Check the direction: the upper mordent goes up to the note above; the lower mordent goes down to the note below.
mistakes.turn-inverted: A turn starts on the note above; an inverted turn starts on the note below.
mistakes.acciaccatura-appoggiatura-swap: Look for the slash through the small note: with it, the note is crushed in quickly (acciaccatura); without it, it takes time from the main note (appoggiatura).
mistakes.trill-mordent-confusion: A trill keeps alternating for the length of the note; a mordent is just one quick alternation.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Compare the shape of the sign with each ornament's pattern.

items.prompt: These written-out notes could be replaced by one ornament sign on the main note. Which ornament is it?

music.textAlternative: Written-out notes around D: D, C, D.

hints: Count the notes and their direction.
Find the main note, then see whether the extra notes go above, below, or both.

feedback.correct: Yes: that sign stands for exactly those notes.

items.prompt: Choose every term that tells you to get gradually slower.
hints: Two of these mean the same thing.

feedback.correct: Both are right: rallentando and ritardando both mean gradually getting slower.

mistakes.opposite-meaning: Accelerando means getting faster: the opposite.

feedback.fallback: Look again: two terms mean gradually slower, one means faster and one means back to the speed before.
